_doc: PYLON 2026 roster/scheme prior file. off_delta and def_delta are in EPA per play. Positive off_delta = better offense. NEGATIVE def_delta = better defense (less EPA allowed). Magnitude guide: full QB tier swap +/-0.100, meaningful QB swap +/-0.035, elite WR1 +/-0.015, DPOY-level edge -0.018, elite CB -0.010, coordinator scheme change +/-0.015, head coach change +/-0.008. Every entry cites the transaction it prices.

ARI.notes: Kyler Murray released, Brissett starts. Jeremiyah Love (1.03) adds rushing floor. Mike LaFleur first year as HC.

ATL.notes: Tua Tagovailoa on a vet-minimum deal over Penix Jr., Stefanski to HC, Tommy Rees OC. Trimmed from an initial +0.030: a minimum-salary QB signing is a hedge, not a tier change.

BAL.notes: Trey Hendrickson 4yr/$112M. Harbaugh out to NYG, Jesse Minter HC, Doyle OC. Continuity loss on offense.

BUF.notes: D.J. Moore trade gives Allen a real WR1. Bradley Chubb + C.J. Gardner-Johnson. McDermott out, Joe Brady promoted.

CAR.notes: Jaelan Phillips 4yr/$120M, Devin Lloyd. Hubbard hamstring, Brazzell lost for year.

CHI.notes: D.J. Moore traded to BUF. Bradbury upgrade at center. Loveland/Burden year two.

CIN.notes: Worst-in-league pass defense rebuilt: Dexter Lawrence, Jonathan Allen, Boye Mafe, Bryan Cook. Offset by losing Hendrickson.

CLE.notes: Traded Myles Garrett (DPOY) for Jared Verse. Watson named starter over Sanders. Monken HC lifts a 32nd-ranked offense off the floor.

DAL.notes: Rashan Gary + Caleb Downs (1.11) + Jalen Thompson attack the worst defensive EPA/play in football. Lost Osa Odighizuwa.

DEN.notes: Jaylen Waddle trade. Nix healthy after two ankle surgeries. Davis Webb first year calling plays.

DET.notes: Petzing OC leans multi-TE. Pacheco replaces Montgomery. Branch and Joseph opened camp on PUP.

GB.notes: Micah Parsons on PUP to mid-October. Gannon takes over defense. Jacobs groin plus pending league discipline. Kraft back.

HOU.notes: David Montgomery trade, three OL additions (Braden Smith, Teller). Jayden Higgins lost for season.

IND.notes: Daniel Jones back from Achilles, Pittman traded to PIT, Pierce extended but on PUP.

JAX.notes: Etienne to NO with no marquee replacement. Quiet offseason on a 13-4 roster, which historically regresses.

KC.notes: Mahomes returns from torn ACL/LCL, Bieniemy back as OC, Kenneth Walker III signed. Lost Trent McDuffie.

LA.notes: Myles Garrett AND Trent McDuffie in one offseason. Stafford is 38. Ty Simpson drafted 1.13 as succession.

LAC.notes: Mike McDaniel takes over the offense. Njoku and Kolar at TE. Biggest scheme upgrade in the league.

LV.notes: Cousins over Geno, Kubiak HC, Linderbaum at center. Paye, Koonce, Quay Walker, Nakobe Dean, Taron Johnson rebuild a 30th-ranked roster.

MIA.notes: Largest single-team downgrade on the board. Tua and Waddle both gone, Malik Willis starting, Hafley HC and Slowik OC installing a new system at once.

MIN.notes: Kyler Murray beat out J.J. McCarthy on a vet-minimum deal. Jauan Jennings added. Defense was 3rd in DVOA and returns intact.

NE.notes: A.J. Brown plus Romeo Doubs around a 22-year-old MVP runner-up. Vera-Tucker, Dre'Mont Jones, Byard.

NO.notes: Travis Etienne signed, Jordyn Tyson (1.08) but hamstring costs two months. Shough year two.

NYG.notes: John Harbaugh HC, Matt Nagy OC, Isaiah Likely. Nabers trending to Week 1 off ACL. Lost Dexter Lawrence.

NYJ.notes: Geno Smith over Fields, Frank Reich OC. Defense that produced FOUR takeaways all year adds Minkah Fitzpatrick, T'Vondre Sweat, Ossai, Enagbare, Onyemata, Demario Davis.

PHI.notes: A.J. Brown traded for a 2028 first plus $43.5M dead cap. Greenard and Woolen added. Makai Lemon (1.20) hamstring.

PIT.notes: Tomlin out after 19 seasons, McCarthy in. Pittman and Dowdle added. Rodgers back at 42. Ramsey and Porter on PUP.

SEA.notes: Champion roster, quiet offseason, lost Kenneth Walker III to KC. Jadarian Price (1.32) replaces him. Charbonnet on PUP.

SF.notes: Mike Evans signed, Kittle off PUP ahead of schedule, Raheem Morris takes over the defense. Pearsall lost for the season.

TB.notes: Mike Evans gone to SF, Mayfield contract talks stalled, Vea holding in. Gainwell and Anzalone added.

TEN.notes: Robert Saleh HC and Brian Daboll OC around Cam Ward year two. Jermaine Johnson, Franklin-Myers, Solomon Thomas, two CBs. Carnell Tate 1.04.

WAS.notes: Stefon Diggs and Chig Okonkwo for Daniels. Oweh, Chenal, Rasul Douglas, Nick Cross against a minus-13 turnover margin.

pace_scheme_2026._doc: Multiplicative adjustment to projected dropback rate for new play-callers. 1.00 = no change.
